learn.title: The zero product property
learn.body: If two numbers multiply to 0, at least one of them is 0. So if $(x-2)(x-3)=0$, then $x-2=0$ or $x-3=0$. This turns a quadratic into two easy equations.

learn.title: Solve $x^2+2x-8=0$
learn.body: Factor, then set each factor to 0.

learn.title: Move everything to one side
learn.body: The trick works only when one side is 0. For $x^2=3x$, first subtract $3x$: $x^2-3x=0$. Then factor: $x(x-3)=0$, so $x=0$ or $x=3$.
Do not divide both sides by $x$. You would lose the solution $x=0$. Factor instead.

questions.prompt: If $a\cdot b=0$, what must be true?
questions.explanation: A product is zero only if one of the factors is zero. This is the zero product property.
